question: Early row embeddings improved raw logistic heads on all three development panels but the chosen tree blend lost 3 and 3. Test the later pretrained representation, after it reads labeled examples. Can the task's fitting labels adapt the final classifier in a strongly regularized low-dimensional subspace?
method: Use four stratified disjoint exact-feature-group folds (seed 72731) of 4061 fitting rows. For each, fit a frozen one-view TabICLv2 reference on three folds. Capture the activation directly before its final output linear layer on the held fold and development query features only. Use no feature or class shuffling. Verify the publisher's prediction from the activations and final weights, and that every training row is represented by a model excluding it and its exact-feature group. No query or head-target labels enter a reference producing their own activation. The four-fold contexts are new because the old probability teachers did not save hidden states.
adapt: Use only the 4061 out-of-fold activations to fit a 32-dimensional whitened principal subspace. Fit penalized logistic changes to (a) the publisher's unmodified class log-odds and (b) the stronger pair's previously sealed out-of-fold log-odds. Keep penalty 24 and clip changes at 1.25. Include a calibration-only comparator using the unmodified score and a constant, and a frozen four-reference comparator. Apply each correction to each query reference individually and then average probabilities. No full-weight language or table model training.
readout: Candidates for the fixed 808-row election are the frozen, calibrated and both hidden-state-adapted predictors. The 817/807 confirmations and .003 pooled with nonnegative per-panel gate are unchanged. These development panels were reused. Any graduate must be evaluated on larger training folds before ordinary-entry consideration. No language-model API, designated validation, final test or H2.
